stumbles.quote: Colour matches a reference to mean ΔE76 0.07.
stumbles.why: The post never says what the reference is (a photo? a physical model? a spectral calculation?). ΔE76 is also unexplained to many developers, so I can't tell how impressive 0.07 is.

stumbles.quote: thick film sinks toward the tilt, thin rises
stumbles.why: "The tilt" is unexplained. I don't know what is tilted, or whether the user tilts the device or the sim does it by itself. It also doesn't say what "rises" means here.

stumbles.quote: black film spreads from the top
stumbles.why: "Black film" is jargon. I'd have to already know it is the very thin film stage that appears just before a bubble pops. The post doesn't say that.

stumbles.quote: Not yet tried on a real phone.
stumbles.why: It doesn't say what it has been tried on, or why a phone matters. That could be a WebGPU support or tilt-sensor issue, but I'm guessing. Without that, I can't tell whether the tilt comes from a phone's sensor.

point: The post shows a WebGPU compute simulation of a soap film where thickness acts as density, so the film drains, thins to black and pops. Its colour is said to match a reference closely, and it hasn't been tested on a phone.
